test_HFRunner: test the HFRunner class to run Hugging Face models in a subprocess for generation, embedding, reward, and cross-encoder tasks
test_SRTRunner: test the SRTRunner class to run SGLang SRT engine for generation, embedding, reward, and cross-encoder tasks
test_check_close_model_outputs: test check_close_model_outputs function to compare Hugging Face and SGLang model outputs using ROUGE-L and logprobs tolerance
test_HFRunner_forward_generation_raw: test HFRunner.forward_generation_raw static method to generate text with logprobs from a Hugging Face base model
test_SRTRunner_forward_generation_raw: test SRTRunner.forward_generation_raw static method to generate text with logprobs from the SGLang engine
